[h1]✦ Zedternal Unlimited — Perk Expansion Pack[/h1]
[i]A massive expansion for Zedternal Reborn that transforms the endless mode into a deep, strategic roguelike experience.[/i]

Zedternal Unlimited introduces [b]30+ brand-new custom perks[/b], each with unique gameplay mechanics that go far beyond simple stat bonuses. Every perk creates an entirely new playstyle with dedicated skill trees, milestone abilities, and custom HUD elements.

[b]This is not just a perk pack — it's a complete gameplay expansion.[/b]

[h2]What Makes This Different[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Every perk creates a new playstyle[/b] — not just damage bonuses, but entirely new mechanics
[*] [b]Level 10 & 20 milestone abilities[/b] that transform how each perk plays
[*] [b]Dedicated skill trees[/b] per perk with unique synergies
[*] [b]Custom HUD elements[/b] for tracking perk-specific mechanics
[*] [b]Full multiplayer support[/b] — works on dedicated servers and listen servers
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h1]⚔ The Perks[/h1]
Zedternal Unlimited features [b]30+ custom perks[/b] organized into themed groups, each with its own visual identity and gameplay philosophy.

Every perk features:
[list]
[*] A [b]unique core mechanic[/b] that defines a new playstyle
[*] [b]Level 10 milestone[/b] — unlocks a new mechanic that changes how you play
[*] [b]Level 20 capstone[/b] — a game-changing ultimate power
[*] [b]Dedicated skill tree[/b] with exclusive skills and synergies
[*] [b]Custom HUD tracking[/b] for perk-specific stats and mechanics
[/list]

[i]Full perk details, themed trees, and skill breakdowns coming soon.[/i]

[hr][/hr]

[h1]✦ Key Features[/h1]

[h2]🎲 Roguelike Upgrade System[/h2]
Every wave brings new choices. Purchase perks, skills, weapons, and equipment upgrades from the trader between waves. Build your character differently every run with six rarity tiers influencing what's available.

[h2]🧬 Evolution & Progression[/h2]
Perks aren't static — they grow with you. Many perks feature dynamic mechanics that respond to your playstyle, rewarding commitment and adaptation.

[h2]⚡ Milestone Abilities[/h2]
Every perk has powerful transformative abilities at Level 10 and Level 20:
[list]
[*] Level 10 unlocks a [b]new mechanic[/b] that changes how you play
[*] Level 20 provides a [b]capstone ability[/b] — a game-changing ultimate power
[/list]

[h2]🎯 Dedicated Skill Trees[/h2]
Each perk comes with its own pool of exclusive skills, creating deep build variety and unique synergies per perk.

[h2]🖥 Custom HUD & UI[/h2]
Perk-specific HUD elements track your unique mechanics — evolution stage counters, dosh trackers, escalation indicators, and more. Everything is cleanly integrated into the existing KF2 interface.

[h2]🎮 Full Multiplayer Support[/h2]
[list]
[*] Works on [b]dedicated servers[/b] and [b]listen servers[/b]
[*] Proper client-server replication for all perk mechanics
[*] All custom HUD elements replicated correctly
[*] No desync issues — extensively tested
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h1]📥 Installation[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Subscribe to this mod on the Steam Workshop
[*] Subscribe to [b]Zedternal Reborn[/b] (required base mod) if you haven't already
[*] Launch Killing Floor 2
[*] The perk pack will be automatically loaded alongside Zedternal Reborn
[*] If you are unfamiliar with .INI files and Server customization, my [url=https://zedternalunlimited.com/configurator]Zedternal Unlimited Website[/url] has an automatic INI Configurator with a user-friendly UI and export / import features so you get to play the Mod exactly how you want to experience it.
[*] If you need any help, feel free to join the [url=https://discord.gg/ytdphknevy]Zedternal Unlimited Discord[/url]. I'm happy always to help!
[/olist]

[b]Requirements:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Killing Floor 2[/b] (latest version)
[*] [b]Zedternal Reborn[/b] — you can find the mod [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2058869377]-> right here <-[/url]
[/list]

[b]Note:[/b] This is a perk expansion pack, not a standalone mod. It adds content to Zedternal Reborn's existing systems.

[hr][/hr]

[h1]🖥 Dedicated Server Setup[/h1]

[h2]Quick Setup[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Subscribe to both Zedternal Reborn and Zedternal Unlimited on the Workshop
[*] Add both mods to your server's workshop subscription list
[*] Launch your Server or Singleplayer Game with one of these launch commands [i](replace KF-SteamFortress with any map you like): [/i]

[b]1. Default Zedternal Reborn Gamemode[/b] (random weapons appear in the trader every wave)

[i]KF-SteamFortress?game=ZedternalRBPerkpackage.DKGameInfo_Endless?mutator=ZedternalRBPerkpackage.DKMutator[/i]

[b]2. Zedternal Reborn with All Weapons available in the trader[/b]

[i]KF-SteamFortress?game=ZedternalRBPerkpackage.DKGameInfo_Endless_AllWeapons?mutator=ZedternalRBPerkpackage.DKMutator[/i]
[/olist]

[h2]Server Configuration[/h2]
All perks are fully configurable through [url=https://zedternalunlimited.com/configurator]Zedternal Reborn's configuration system[/url]. Server admins can:
[list]
[*] Enable or disable individual perks
[*] Adjust perk availability per wave
[*] Configure skill pools and restrictions
[*] Use the Zedternal Configurator tool for easy setup
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h1]❓ FAQ / Troubleshooting[/h1]

[h2]Q: Do I need Zedternal Reborn installed?[/h2]
[b]Yes.[/b] This is an expansion pack for Zedternal Reborn. It extends the base mod's systems and cannot function without it.

[h2]Q: Will this break my existing Zedternal Reborn setup?[/h2]
No. Zedternal Unlimited adds content alongside existing perks — it doesn't replace or modify any base Zedternal Reborn content. Your existing perks and configuration remain untouched.

[h2]Q: Does this work on dedicated servers?[/h2]
Yes! Full dedicated server support with proper client-server replication. All custom HUD elements and perk mechanics work correctly in multiplayer.

[h2]Q: How do I unlock hidden perks?[/h2]
Some perks have unlock conditions that require specific combinations of other perks or levels. Experiment and explore — that's part of the fun!

[h2]Q: Can I configure which perks are available?[/h2]
Absolutely. Server admins have full control over which perks appear in the trader, their wave availability, and associated skill pools.

[h2]Q: Is this compatible with other Zedternal Reborn perk packs?[/h2]
Yes! Zedternal Unlimited follows the same extension patterns as other perk packs and should be compatible.

[h2]Q: I found a bug / have a suggestion[/h2]
Please report bugs and share suggestions on our [url=https://discord.gg/ytdphknevy]Discord server[/url] or in the comments section below. Include steps to reproduce for bugs.
